description: Ask your human before a risky or irreversible step (deploying, paying, deleting, emailing real people). Emails the workspace owner a link; only they can answer, signed in. Returns an id and answerUrl (show it in chat too), then call wait_for_approval. Needs an approved workspace key.

details.description: Optional context: what will happen, diff summary, cost.

question.description: One clear question, up to 500 characters.

name: ask_human
